issues.problem: w 'hotrāḥ' is feminine nom/acc pl. but gram and notes say neuter pl.; the neuter plural is hotrā, which is also the printed form.
Enclitic vām is acc./dat./gen. dual; gram says 'du. acc.' and gloss 'to you two' (dative sense) which disagree, and 'yoke to you two' is one reading among several (often 'your ancient brahma').
issues.fix: gram: enclitic du., acc./dat./gen.; give a case-neutral gloss such as 'you two (enclitic)' and mention in notes that 'your' (gen.) is also possible.
